description: This file contains the implementation of the generic class 'TransactionalState<TState>' which manages transactional state in an Orleans grain, including methods for performing read and update operations within transaction contexts, setup procedures, and logging.

classes.name: TransactionalState`1
classes.description: A stateful class that implements transaction semantics for an Orleans grain, supporting read and write operations within transactions, state restoration, and resource management.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Performs a transactional read operation, managing locks and transaction context, with reentrancy detection.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs a transactional update operation, with lock management, deep copying of state, and reentrancy checks.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the transactional state to the grain lifecycle for state setup.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes the transactional state, including resource registration and state recovery.
